# VaR / expected shortfall (`var` v1)

Historical VaR and ES for a desk or portfolio, with backtesting.

**Group:** Market risk · **Mnemonic:** `VAR` · **Identifiers:** `VAR-…` in `resultId`

Open one with `VAR <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: var
version: 1
description: "Historical VaR and ES for a desk or portfolio, with backtesting."
match: { kind: var, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market risk · VaR / expected shortfall, id: $.resultId }
strip:
  - { label: VaR 99% 1D, bind: $.var99, fmt: compact, emphasis: true }
  - { label: ES 97.5%, bind: $.es975, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Stressed VaR, bind: $.svar, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Limit, bind: $.limit, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Exceptions (250d), bind: $.exceptions }
panels:
  - id: pnl
    kind: line
    title: "Hypothetical P&L, last 60 days"
    key: F2
    rows: $.pnlSeries
    x: date
    y: pnl
    fmt: signed0

    kind: hbar
    title: VaR contribution by book
    area: right

    value: var
    fmt: compact
```
